comment: The 4 Main Street Pillars page. Content sourced from the LFCD committee presentation of July 23, 2026 (slides 3, 4, 12, 13, 15) and the LFCD Board of Directors organizational chart. Committee labels per the LFCD committee; Main Street America (MSA) four points shown alongside.
mission: The Lake Forest Cultural District works to cultivate a vibrant, inclusive, and sustainable cultural corridor that increases the attendance, participation, and sales for cultural anchors and businesses with a desire and heart to uplift, support, retain, and attract cultural economy activities and programs in the City of New Orleans.
purpose: Increase event attendance and sales in the region.
intro: The LFCD committee organizes the district's work around four pillars, aligned with Main Street America's proven four-point approach. Each pillar is a working committee with its own sub-committees and outcomes, drawn from the objectives in the 2025 LFCD state application.

pillars.msaFocus: Build leadership and strong organizational capacity. Ensure broad community engagement. Forge partnerships across sectors.
pillars.note: The proposed governance structure below sits under this pillar.

pillars.msaFocus: Create an inviting, inclusive atmosphere. Celebrate historic character. Foster accessible, people-centered public spaces.
pillars.outcome: Identify resources; map cultural, community, and economic assets.

pillars.msaFocus: Build a diverse economic base. Catalyze smart new investment. Cultivate a strong entrepreneurship ecosystem.
pillars.outcome: Improve business growth initiatives for cultural asset growth.
pillars.note: The Louisiana State Commercial Historic Tax Credit — the financial tool behind the district's building rehabilitation case — works under this pillar. See the Buildings page for the full program details.

pillars.msaFocus: Market the district's defining assets. Communicate unique features through storytelling. Support a buy-local experience.
pillars.outcome: Create the logo, social media, ads, and outreach.

governance.title: Proposed governance: the Board of Directors
governance.alt: Lake Forest Cultural District Board of Directors organizational chart: a President over Vice President, Secretary, Treasurer and two district-resident members, over nine members — four of whom are residents of the district representing Zones 1 through 4. Total board members: 13.
governance.summary: Total board members: 13. Officers — President, Vice President, Secretary, Treasurer (4). Members — 9, four of whom are residents of the Lake Forest Cultural District, representing Zones 1–4.
governance.status: Proposed structure under committee review — first of three votes in progress as of July 2026.
